title: Rec FDR v43 S1 strict deterministic full SFT
purpose: Use the deterministic configuration validated by the 10-step A/B benchmark to run one complete SFT from the shared pretrained initialization.
hypothesis: The strict FA2, cuBLAS, CUDA connection, NCCL Ring/Simple, and TF32 settings will preserve the intended 475-step SFT trajectory while making an independently repeated run byte reproducible on the same stack.
changes: Set FLASH_ATTENTION_DETERMINISTIC=1, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1, NCCL_ALGO=Ring, NCCL_PROTO=Simple, and NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0.
Disable intermediate checkpoint writes while retaining evaluation milestones at 20%, 40%, 80%, and 100%.
Save only the final BF16 full-model weights in the run root and record their SHA-256.

dataset.summary: Frozen rec_fdr_v43_hcr_frozen_v42a training and external deterministic validation split, using the established 32K tokenized curriculum pools.

model.training_method: Full-parameter BF16 SFT with FA2, Liger, gradient checkpointing, and four-GPU FSDP full shard

config_summary.label: Schedule
config_summary.value: 1 epoch, 475 optimizer steps, batch size 1/GPU, gradient accumulation 4, cosine LR 2e-5

config_summary.label: Checkpoint policy
config_summary.value: No intermediate weights; retain final model.safetensors only

config_summary.label: Determinism
config_summary.value: Six strict environment controls exactly matching the successful 10-step A/B test

expected_result: Complete all 475 optimizer steps without recovery, write one loadable final model.safetensors, and preserve full trainer logs and evaluation milestones for later stability assessment.
notes: Completed all 475 optimizer steps without recovery. Final train loss was 1.1368073997999493 and runtime was 22108.9432 seconds. No intermediate checkpoint directory was produced. The final 16,779,959,728-byte safetensors file passed its recorded SHA-256 check and exposed all 399 tensors. The six inference files were uploaded to the verified private ModelScope repository recorded in modelscope_upload.
